transcript: You must learn to listen when your body whispers. Before sickness shouts, the body always speaks. When you wake up tired, though you've slept all night, your adrenals have grown weary from too much stress and sugar. Drink warm water with a pinch of sea salt at sunrise and let your energy rise naturally, not borrowed from caffeine. When you crave sweetness after every meal, it is not hunger, it is your body asking for magnesium and chromium. Feed it with dark chocolate, nuts and leafy green and the cravings will fade like fog before the morning sun. When your hands and feet are always cold, your inner fire, the thyroid, has grown weak, nourish it with iodine, selenium and warm soups and you will feel life's warmth return to your skin. When your stomach bloats or feels heavy after meals, your digestive fire is tired sip ginger tea. Take slow walks and avoid the cold drinks that extinguish that inner flame. When the skin breaks out again and again, it is not the surface that is sick. It is the liver that cries rest well, drink lemon water and let the body cleanse through sleep. Remember this my student, never fight your body. Every symptom is a whisper from nature itself. Find the root, restore balance and healing will come without force. If you wish to learn the ancient healing methods I use to help thousands of people, you will find them all in my ebook. The link rests quietly in my profile.
